about: How each semver-major commit between Node lines is classed, as read from its title in Node's own changelog (not from its diff, except where `read` says so). a: not observable by a running server application. b: additive (the newer line has what the older lacked). c: a default or a behaviour changed. d: removed, or throws where the older line did not. e: a warning only the newer line prints. v: the JavaScript engine's (V8), which in a tab is the browser's for every line. Rules are tried in order on `subsystem: title`; `byPr` overrides them.
rules: runtime deprecat|^[a-z_,]+: deprecate |emit warning|to runtime deprecation

49140: crypto streams no longer overwrite the writable's defaultEncoding
42835: fs read methods validate `position` more strictly
50167: a corked chunked HTTP response is written in fewer parts: the bytes on the wire differ, the body does not
47497: structuredClone or postMessage of a URL or URLSearchParams throws
47769: a `navigator` global appears: code that feature-tests `typeof navigator` to tell a browser from Node takes the other branch
48606: an error code for a module failure changed
48276: server.maxConnections = 0 now refuses every connection instead of meaning no limit
47839: the error thrown for an uncloneable object is a DOMException
47604: the error thrown for an untransferable object is a DataCloneError
50908: fs.Stats date fields are made on first read
50394: writeHead after setHeader keeps duplicate raw headers
51594: a global WebSocket appears: a library that picks `ws` only when no global exists takes the other branch
51362: V8 12.x: the Iterator global and what came with that engine update
52037: streams' default highWaterMark is 64 KiB, was 16 KiB: chunk sizes and backpressure points move
53495: assert.deepStrictEqual and util.isDeepStrictEqual compare WeakMap and WeakSet by identity
54588: buffer writes past the end throw ERR_BUFFER_OUT_OF_BOUNDS
54761: a V8 command-line flag is gone: a start command that passes it fails
52611: --no-experimental-fetch is gone: a start command that passes it fails
53305: an scrypt parameter error has another code
53848: an ES module importing CommonJS also gets a 'module.exports' export name
54965: AbortSignal arguments are validated by interface: an object that only looks like a signal is refused
54224: path results for some edge inputs changed
52347: binding a pipe to a path too long for sockaddr_un fails instead of truncating
53241: stream.pipeline to a closed or destroyed stream errors
58154: Float16Array and explicit resource management are the engine's
57586: http2 server.close() waits for sessions and closes them gracefully
57591: readline splits on Unicode line separators
51821: buffer functions validate their length argument's range
57069: clearImmediate ignores what is not an Immediate
55270: an error thrown by a destination's write during pipe is forwarded as the stream's error
56082: AsyncResource carries an async context frame
55552: AsyncLocalStorage is built on AsyncContextFrame, not async_hooks: what a store propagates through in edge cases, and its cost, differ
43624: crypto.setFips throws when called from a worker thread
44769: an fs buffer argument's error is another error
42772: fs.read, fs.readSync and filehandle.read check their arguments more strictly
43522: the global http and https agents keep connections alive by default: a server sees its Node clients reuse sockets, and an idle client holds one open
44483: web performance interfaces as globals, and event handler properties check their receiver
42083: a global crypto (WebCrypto): code that tests `typeof crypto` takes the other branch
44349: path.format adds the dot when `ext` lacks it
44312: a stream's callback gets null, not undefined, for no error
44031: TLS and http2 send a fatal alert on an ALPN mismatch
46067: WebCrypto validates its arguments by WebIDL: values it used to coerce are refused
46333: an HTTP response with a body and no declared length closes the connection after it
46331: HTTP/1.1 connections stay alive even when the Connection header is removed
46283: http.Server throws for options given as an array
45597: an HTTP/1.1 request with no Host header is answered 400 by the server
46790: net connects with autoSelectFamily by default (tries IPv6 and IPv4 addresses in turn): which address a client reaches, and how long a failed connect takes, differ
45526: url.parse() warns for an invalid port
